authFilesToStage: .local/share/kilo/auth.json (the data dir file `kilo auth login` writes; the string is in the 7.8.3 binary and `kilo debug paths` gives data=$XDG_DATA_HOME/kilo; absent on this host, so staging was not exercised)
.config/kilo/kilo.jsonc and kilo.json (user config; kilo.jsonc is created fresh by first use)

contained.evidence: All 13 created files are under the temp HOME (kilo.db with -shm/-wal holds the sessions, log/, storage/session_diff, telemetry-id, models.json cache, config/kilo, a sandbox-policy json under .local/state); 0 under the cwd, 0 under TMPDIR, 0 touched in the real native dirs, no process left running (KILO_NO_DAEMON=1), real home top level unchanged.

notes: Registry entry is `refused`: kilo runs with explicit full access only and a sections org refuses policy.access "full" (documents/definition.ts checkRoles), so no sections role can run on it. The files below record where its copies would land (a private HOME would contain them), for any later change to that rule.

Turn: `kilo run --format json --dangerously-skip-permissions --model openrouter/qwen/qwen3.8-27b:free "reply with OK"` (zero-priced model; step_finish reported cost 0, 15990 tokens); the provider key came from OPENROUTER_API_KEY in the environment, nothing was staged and no login was done.

kilo 7.8.3 was installed with npm into a throwaway prefix under /var/tmp with HOME/XDG pointed into a throwaway directory; npm did not run the postinstall script. No install step touched the real home.

`kilo debug paths` with HOME=<tmp>: data=$HOME/.local/share/kilo, cache=$HOME/.cache/kilo, config=$HOME/.config/kilo, state=$HOME/.local/state/kilo, tmp=$TMPDIR/kilo, bin=$HOME/.cache/kilo/bin. Every directory derives from HOME/XDG_*, so a private home contains all of them.
The runner sets no HOME itself (it spawns with env = process.env + args.env), so the session's isolation env reaches the child (env-boundary.test.ts).
